prompt:
A desktop web app screen for Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent, Hive, works on its own computer. Edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window or device. The four references are Linear's real product screens: copy their flat language exactly (near-black surfaces, three greys of text, hairline borders, status as a tiny icon plus coloured text with no filled chips, a person's message as a small dark rounded bubble, the agent's work collapsed into one dim line like 'Worked for 12 seconds ▸', a result card with a quiet 'Restore' link), but none of their content or branding.
Shell: a narrow plain sidebar with Hive's small bee logo, workspace 'Fern & Fig' with a chevron, a search field, then plain text items with tiny line icons: Inbox, Activity, Goals, Files, Calendar, and a section 'Channels' with launch (active), design, ops, hiring, a section 'Threads' with two items, 'Computer · online' at the bottom, no icon rail, no big labels.
Main: header '# launch' with small grey '6 members'. Conversation: Priya 'Photos are in. The hero for the email is the maidenhair fern.'; Marcus (right-aligned dark bubble) '@hive what do we still need before the send?'; then Hive's reply as plain text: 'Four things are open for the launch:' followed by a flat list of four rows, each a tiny status icon, the task name and a coloured status word: Write the launch email, Needs review (honey); Schedule the launch send, Blocked (grey); Set up the pre-order page, Running (sage green); Order 8-inch boxes, Failed (muted red). Then a dim line 'Worked for 18 minutes ▸' and one flat result card: 'Write the launch email', grey meta 'Agent · Due Fri', buttons 'Mark done' and 'Send back'. A flat composer at the bottom with a small send arrow.
Colour: honey #F2B632 only on what needs a person and the primary button, sage #7FAE92 for running and online, red only for failed. No shadows, glass, blur or gradients.
Look: Linear's light theme. White ground #FFFFFF, sidebar #F7F8F7, hairlines #E7E9E7, near-black text and two greys, honey for needs-review shown with a deeper amber #C98A00 for legibility, sage #4F8A68 for running.
